summary: Tested the expanded 'search elsewhere' protocol. Backend: GET application returns 17 search_links (employer site + 12 general incl. Glassdoor + 4 Québec), each with label/url/quebec; auto_sources=['Portail officiel']. Province ordering verified: when the profile province is Québec (or empty, falling back to the Montréal offer location), Jobillico/Jobboom/Québec emploi/Isarta come right after Indeed/LinkedIn; with Ontario they come last; the province was restored to ''. POST availability?search=true returns 1 alternative (Portail officiel), no Careerjet. UI at /careeros/candidature/:id: auto-sources text correct, 17 anchors target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, Québec ones sky-blue (rgb(3,105,161)), 'Tout ouvrir (17)' opened 16 real tabs in headless (Eluta tab did not appear, and eluta.ca is unreachable from this container: environment issue, not the app). The blocked-popup toast was verified by stubbing window.open: '17 onglet(s) bloqué(s)…'. At 390px mobile, apply-bar, offer-availability and search-links have no overflow.

issues: In the alternative row (alternative-0), the title span (flex-1 truncate) shrinks to about 10px and shows only 'A.' because the source badge, the match % and the two buttons take all the width. Make it wrap: put the title on its own full-width line (basis-full) on small screens.

Already present before this change (outside the apply-bar): the PackView header row (priority badge, IPS, status select, 'Préparer l'entrevue', pack-more-btn) overflows by 12px (document scrollWidth 402 > 390). Add flex-wrap.

The Monster link (monster.ca/jobs/search?q=…) is redirected with 301 to the monster.com homepage, so the search query is lost. Use a Google site:monster.ca search or the monster.ca format that currently works.

'Tout ouvrir' fires 6 Google 'site:' searches at once (Jobboom, Québec emploi, Isarta, CareerBeacon, Workopolis, Google Emplois). In headless they all hit google.com/sorry (captcha). Real users may also hit Google rate limits; consider spacing them out.

action_items: Fix the Monster search URL: monster.ca redirects to the monster.com homepage and drops the query.
Mobile: let the alternative title wrap instead of truncating to 'A.'.
Mobile: add flex-wrap to the PackView header action row (12px horizontal overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: The review request gives the UI path /careeros/pack/:id, but the actual route is /careeros/candidature/:id.
router.get_app runs KB.lookup, a career_profiles query and _offer_meta on every GET. This is acceptable, but search_links could be cached.
The availability endpoint trusts the first X-Forwarded-For IP for Careerjet's user_ip. This is acceptable behind the ingress.
seed_data_creation: None. Profile province was changed temporarily and restored to ''. offer_link is https://example.com/jobs/TEST_123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The PackView route is /careeros/candidature/:id. backend pytest.ini uses xdist (-n): pass -n 0 to see print output. test_search_links.py toggles the profile province (Québec, then Ontario) and restores it. The app's offer is expired (example.com 404), so the alternatives box shows 1 Portail officiel alternative.
